scope: Wave 1 control-plane and UX-shell implementation slice
implemented_capabilities: Opportunity command-center projection and page surfacing
Notification acknowledgement, quiet-hours preference update, and failed-delivery retry actions
Workflow audit explorer with run reconstruction by workflow instance and subject filters

resolved_findings: Dashboard and portal queries now apply workflow viewer scope before pagination and compute dashboard totals from all authorized rows.
Opportunity command-center audit projection now avoids direct audit reads unless the viewer is global or directly assigned to the opportunity, and otherwise uses visible workflow IDs.
Workflow reversal now persists target-state visibility and clears stale portal visibility for cancelled/resolved/reopened states that are not portal-visible.
